title: Recommendation Serving
currentHint: Saving creates a new version; changes apply to recommendations served from then on.
minFavouriteOrdersHint: A customer needs at least this many orders of an item before it counts as a favourite.
minPairSampleHint: A pairing's share is only shown when the item has at least this many orders to base it on.
strongPairingLiftHint: Minimum lift for a pairing to count as strong. 1 means no association; decimals are allowed.
bestSellerMaxRankHint: Items ranked at or above this position are marked as best sellers.
bestSellerMinListSizeHint: Best sellers are only marked when the list has at least this many items.

history.title: Version History
history.restoreConfirmDescription: This creates a new version with these settings and makes it the current one.
